_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for 4-megas-and-a-destrier, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). The list was first imported from New Recruit’s PDF (verify/import-nr.js); these are the values data.js had then that its JSON export and GW’s pages do not give, each as data.js showed it and as its review signed it off: source (the day the PDF was exported; the export has none), units.<id>: na (why an ability does nothing in this list), notes (an FAQ or a rules note under an ability), kwNote (where a keyword comes from), short (the short name), srcNote (a note on the sources), kwOnly and partialRules (which model has a keyword or a core ability only some models of the unit have, where GW’s pages do not say it mechanically).

source.why: the day New Recruit’s PDF of this list was exported (verify/sources/nr/4-megas-and-a-destrier.txt), from which the list was first imported; the JSON export carries no date

srcNote.note: Wahapedia: his own EPIC HERO datasheet; BSData and New Recruit: in this unit

canis-rex.why: srcNote: GW (Wahapedia) prints Sir Hekhtur on his own EPIC HERO datasheet (imperial-knights_Sir-Hekhtur.html); BSData and New Recruit have him as a model of the Canis Rex unit, as the app does. The note on his models line says so.

na.Thundercharge: Needs a thundershock spear and bellatus reaper chainsword: not this loadout

knight-destrier.why: Thundercharge needs the thundershock spear and the bellatus reaper chainsword (GW's datasheet); this list's Destrier has titanic feet (New Recruit's export), so it does nothing here.
